description: At Marmaria, three Doric columns and a short curved entablature stand on the round podium of the Tholos, with the rest of the circle only a foundation. Olive groves and the Pleistos valley drop away below. The morning is clear, about 17.4°C. The Temple of Apollo, the theater, and the Castalian Spring are not in the frame.
